value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical 18-vertex symmetric Levi graph with 216 automorphisms. Its complete topological character has 13 group conjugacy classes and nontrivially distinguishes two order-three elements with identical vertex and edge cycle data; it determines reduced rational homology for full and index-two symmetry quotients, which a known 10-dimensional Betti number and a single C3-restriction do not determine. This exact natural equivariant invariant provides a meaningful structural topological distinction rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
